messages:
Ava (People Ops): Quick update for everyone — were shifting the attestation deadline due to an auditor scheduling change. New company-wide deadline: 08/15 EOD. We know some teams already finished; thank you! This thread covers the change, staggered deadlines for APAC, and the exception process.

Ava (People Ops): Key points: 1) Complete the 10-min privacy refresher and short quiz (link) by 08/15. 2) Submit the attestation form (mobile-friendly link) by 08/15. 3) Control owners only: upload any updated artifacts to /Evidence/Annual-2026 and update the tracker.

Ava (People Ops): APAC folks: well allow a 48h window after the main deadline to account for local working days — please note that in the tracker so auditors see it.

Jordan (Security): New policy note: retention window for ephemeral logs was extended from 30 to 45 days last quarter. If you rely on ephemeral exports for SI controls, include a README that states the retention window and export timeframe. Example README header: "Retention: 45 days; Export window: 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-01".

Priya (Privacy): If your artifact contains sample PII, options: 1) upload a redacted version + redaction rationale; 2) if redaction breaks the artifact, file an "attest-exception" ticket and attach a justification. Legal will review within 72h.

Kai (Legal): Small legal reminder: if an artifact references a third-party contract or NDA text, do not publish the contract directly. Instead upload a short excerpt plus a pointer to the contract in the legal vault and add a note in the tracker.

Ava (People Ops): New filename guidance (minor tweak): team_controlid_briefdesc_YYYYMMDD[_projcode].pdf. Project code is optional and recommended for cross-team artifacts. Example: eng_AC-6_cors-logs_20260805_proj-falcon.pdf.

ComplianceBot: Notice: 3 outstanding attestations for Eng, 2 for Data. Office hours scheduled Mon & Wed 10:30-11:30 in #help for quick filename checks.

Jordan (Security): For large exports (>50MB) — upload the JSON to the evidence S3 bucket and include a small manifest PDF (filename pattern above) that links to the S3 path and contains an MD5 checksum.

Priya (Privacy): Folks who completed the earlier sprint: please re-check the filenames comply with the new pattern and update the tracker. Were only re-reviewing artifacts with changed filenames.

Ava (People Ops): Exceptions: open an "attest-exception" ticket and tag @Kai/@Jordan/@Priya. For contractor-owned artifacts, add the contractor manager as the owner in the tracker.

Kai (Legal): If youre unsure about publishing anything, DM legal first — better to flag than to re-upload.

Ava (People Ops): TL;DR: deadline moved to 08/15 EOD, APAC gets +48h, do the refresher + quiz, submit attestation, upload artifacts with new filename pattern, use office hours for help. Ping me for anything unclear. :spiral_calendar:
